definitions.explanation: A building or structure that has been recently constructed. Also used as a noun meaning 'new construction' or as a no-adjective meaning 'newly built.'

examples.japanese: {新築|しんちく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I moved into a newly built apartment building.

examples.japanese: {新築|しんちく}⟦{一戸建|いっこだ}て→一戸建て：19687_ikkodate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I purchased a newly built detached house.

examples.japanese: {新築|しんちく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It still smells like new construction.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{新|しん} (new) + {築|ちく} (construction, building)

VERB FORM:
・{新築|しんちく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to newly construct)

CONTRAST:
・{新築|しんちく} (newly built) ↔ ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧ (used, pre-owned)
・{新築|しんちく} ↔ ⟦{築|ちく}→築：29014_chiku⟧〇⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (〇 years old building)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{増築|ぞうちく}→増築：06568_zouchiku⟧ (building extension)
・⟦{改築|かいちく}→改築：06224_kaichiku⟧ (renovation, rebuilding)
・⟦{建|た}て{替|か}え→建て替え：19739_tatekae⟧ (rebuilding)
・⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ (architecture, construction)

REAL ESTATE VOCABULARY:
・{新築|しんちく}⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧ (newly built property)
・{新築|しんちく}⟦{分譲|ぶんじょう}→分譲：06577_bunjou⟧ (new for-sale housing)
・{新築|しんちく}⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧ (new condominium building)
・{新築|しんちく}⟦{戸建|こだ}て→戸建て：15623_kodate⟧ (new detached house)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{新築|しんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧ (to build new construction)
・{新築|しんちく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧ (to live in a new building)
・{新築|しんちく}⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧ (housewarming gift)
